title: Vault Manifest Schema
description: Production-grade JSON Schema specification for Vault configuration, security posture baseline, and deployment manifests.

$schema.description: URI or local relative path to the Vault manifest schema against which this document is validated.

name.description: Unique, lowercase machine-readable identifier of the application (kebab-case).

displayName.description: Human-readable display name of the application.

version.description: Semantic version string conforming to SemVer 2.0.0 specifications.

schemaVersion.description: Version number for the manifest schema specification.

securityVersion.description: Version number representing the enforced security baseline.

description.description: Detailed description of the application purpose and security model.

license.description: Software license identifier (e.g. SPDX license identifier, UNLICENSED, or PROPRIETARY).

homepage.description: Optional URL to the application homepage or project landing page, or null.

keywords.description: Keywords, tags, and classification identifiers for the vault project.

securityHeaders.description: List of HTTP response security headers enforced across all endpoints.

features.description: Complete list of functional capabilities and user-facing features supported by the application.

maintainers.description: List of active code owners, core maintainers, and security contacts.

role.description: Role or title of the author.

website.description: Author's personal website or profile URL.

maintainer.title: Maintainer
maintainer.description: Project maintainer or code owner details.

role.description: Maintainer's specific responsibilities or team role.

type.description: Type of version control system hosting the repository.

url.description: Public URL or remote address of the repository.

application.title: Application Configuration
application.description: Application environment, target platforms, and production readiness configuration.

type.description: Categorical type of the secure vault application.

pwa.description: Whether Progressive Web App capabilities are enabled.

production.description: Whether the application is configured for production operation.

security.title: Security Posture Baseline
security.description: Cryptographic standards, key management policies, and authentication specifications.

model.description: Core zero-knowledge threat and access model.

clientSideEncryption.description: True if all sensitive data is encrypted on the client device prior to transit.

zeroKnowledge.description: True if the server never possesses encryption keys or unencrypted data.

plaintextServerAccess.description: False to enforce that backend infrastructure has zero plaintext access to user data.

cryptography.description: Cryptographic algorithm configurations and parameter requirements.

algorithm.description: Authenticated symmetric cipher used for content encryption.

authenticatedEncryption.description: Must be true to guarantee ciphertext integrity via AEAD.

saltLengthBytes.description: Cryptographic salt length in bytes (minimum 16 bytes).

memoryCost.description: Optional memory cost parameter for memory-hard KDFs (e.g. Argon2).

algorithm.description: Initialization vector or nonce generation method.

lengthBytes.description: Nonce length in bytes (12 bytes for standard AES-GCM).

neverReuse.description: Must be true to prevent catastrophic GCM nonce reuse.

provider.description: Cryptographically secure pseudorandom number generator (CSPRNG) provider.

cryptographicallySecure.description: Must be true to certify entropy source suitability.

encryptionFormatVersion.description: Binary or serialized ciphertext envelope format version.

keyManagement.description: Key life-cycle, versioning, and storage policies.

clientGenerated.description: True if master key is derived or generated exclusively on the client.

storedPlaintext.description: False to enforce that unencrypted keys are never persisted.

exportable.description: Controls whether master keys can be exported by the browser runtime.

keyVersioning.description: Whether encryption envelopes track key version IDs for seamless rotation.

keyRotation.description: Whether scheduled or on-demand re-wrapping and key rotation are supported.

multiFactorAuthentication.description: Whether MFA is enforced or supported.

passwordAuthentication.description: Whether master password authentication is enabled.

passwordPolicy.description: Password strength parameters and credential handling policies.

allowPasswordManagers.description: True if inputs do not block pasting from password managers.

allowPassphrases.description: True if multi-word passphrases with spaces are allowed.

sessionSecurity.description: Session token configuration and transport protections.

secureCookies.description: True if session cookies have the Secure attribute.

httpOnlyCookies.description: True if session cookies have the HttpOnly flag.

sessionExpiration.description: True if inactive or maximum lifetime session expiration is enforced.

sessionRevocation.description: True if sessions can be immediately revoked server-side.

concurrentSessionManagement.description: True if users can inspect and terminate concurrent active sessions.

rateLimiting.description: True if authentication endpoints are protected by IP and account rate limiters.

bruteForceProtection.description: True if exponential backoff or lockouts thwart brute-force attacks.

credentialStuffingProtection.description: True if protections against automated credential stuffing are enforced.

recovery.description: Emergency account recovery and zero-knowledge fallback options.

enabled.description: Whether zero-knowledge account recovery workflows are enabled.

backupCodes.description: Whether single-use emergency backup recovery codes are generated.

recoveryKeys.description: Whether cryptographic account recovery keys are supported.

storage.title: Storage Configuration
storage.description: Storage categorization, upload constraints, and client-side encryption enforcement.

encryptionBeforeUpload.description: Must be true to ensure payloads are encrypted before leaving the client.

encryptionAtRest.description: Must be true to guarantee stored records remain encrypted at rest.

encryptedFilenames.description: True if original filenames and paths are encrypted in the manifest and storage.

encryptedMetadata.description: True if item metadata (mime-types, tags, sizes) is encrypted client-side.

contentIntegrityVerification.description: True if cryptographic hashes or AEAD tags verify integrity on retrieval.

maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum permitted single file upload size in megabytes.

multipart.description: Whether chunked/multipart file uploads are supported.

resumable.description: Whether interrupted uploads can be resumed without restarting.

fileTypeValidation.description: Whether client and server validate file extensions and mime types.

contentValidation.description: Whether file contents are inspected for malicious structures.

dataLifecycle.title: Data Lifecycle
dataLifecycle.description: User data retention, export, and GDPR/CCPA deletion guarantees.

userExport.description: Whether users can download a complete encrypted export of their vault.

accountDeletion.description: Whether users can permanently delete their account and associated data.

itemDeletion.description: Whether individual items can be permanently purged.

softDelete.description: False to enforce immediate cryptographic shredding upon deletion.

retentionPolicy.description: Whether automated data retention guidelines are active.

backupRetentionDays.description: Number of days before encrypted system backups are rotated out.

apiSecurity.title: API Security
apiSecurity.description: API boundary controls, TLS requirements, and request protection.

httpsRequired.description: Must be true to forbid plaintext HTTP communication.

cors.description: Whether Cross-Origin Resource Sharing is strictly constrained.

csrfProtection.description: Whether CSRF mitigation is active across state-changing endpoints.

rateLimiting.description: Whether incoming API traffic is governed by rate limiters.

requestValidation.description: Whether all request payloads undergo schema validation.

inputSanitization.description: Whether input data is sanitized against injection attacks.

securityHeaders.description: Whether defense-in-depth security headers are attached to responses.

requestSizeLimits.description: Whether maximum payload byte limits are enforced to thwart DoS attacks.

database.title: Database Security
database.description: Database engine, connection encryption, and backup configurations.

tlsRequired.description: Must be true to mandate encrypted connections to the database.

applicationLevelEncryption.description: True if application performs field or envelope encryption before DB writes.

sensitiveFieldsEncrypted.description: True if all confidential fields are encrypted in the database collections.

credentialsFromEnvironment.description: True if DB connection strings and credentials are read exclusively from environment variables.

enabled.description: Whether automated database backups are enabled.

retentionDays.description: Database backup retention period in days.

encrypted.description: Must be true to ensure DB backup archives are encrypted.

privacy.title: Privacy Posture
privacy.description: User privacy controls, data telemetry, and tracking policies.

tracking.description: Must be false to forbid cross-site user tracking.

thirdPartyDataSharing.description: Must be false to prevent user data sharing with third parties.

advertising.description: Must be false to guarantee an ad-free service.

enabled.description: Whether diagnostic telemetry collection is active.

logging.title: Logging & Audit Trail
logging.description: Structured logging, security auditing, and sensitive data redaction.

structured.description: Whether logs are output in structured JSON format.

auditLogs.description: Whether critical user and administrative actions generate immutable audit logs.

securityEvents.description: Whether authentication and authorization failures produce security log events.

enabled.description: Whether automatic secret redaction is enforced before logs are written.

redactPasswords.description: Redacts passwords and credentials from log outputs.

redactEncryptionKeys.description: Redacts encryption keys and derived keys from log outputs.

redactTokens.description: Redacts session tokens, JWTs, and bearer tokens.

redactRecoveryCodes.description: Redacts emergency recovery codes and master recovery keys.

redactPlaintextContent.description: Redacts user plaintexts, notes, and file payloads from log messages.

observability.title: Observability & Diagnostics
observability.description: Health checks, metrics endpoints, error tracking, and performance monitoring.

metrics.description: Whether application runtime metrics are collected and exported.

errorTracking.description: Whether real-time error tracking and alerting (e.g. Sentry) are configured.

performanceMonitoring.description: Whether application performance tracing (APM) is configured.

performance.title: Performance Specifications
performance.description: Memory constraints, upload limits, and optimization techniques.

maxUploadSizeMB.description: Maximum upload payload size in megabytes.

recommendedMemoryMB.description: Recommended server runtime RAM allocation in megabytes.

compression.description: Whether HTTP response compression (e.g. gzip, brotli) is applied.

lazyLoading.description: Whether client lazily loads heavy assets and code chunks.

streamingUploads.description: Whether media and large files stream directly to storage.

chunkedUploads.description: Whether file uploads support chunked pipelining.

workerBasedEncryption.description: Whether client cryptography runs inside Web Workers to avoid main-thread UI jank.

runtime.title: Runtime Environment
runtime.description: Target server runtime, Node.js version requirements, and process lifecycle.

gracefulShutdown.description: Whether SIGINT/SIGTERM triggers graceful shutdown of connections and servers.

deployment.title: Deployment Guidelines
deployment.description: Production environment criteria and secret management policies.

healthChecks.description: Whether load-balancer health checks are bound and functional.

gracefulShutdown.description: Whether zero-downtime rolling deploys and graceful draining are supported.

environmentSecrets.description: True if production secrets are provided via environment variables or secret vaults.

secretsInRepository.description: Must be false to certify no plaintext secrets or certificates are committed to Git.

testing.title: Testing Assurance
testing.description: Test suite coverage flags across unit, integration, crypto, and security levels.

unit.description: Automated unit tests present and passing.

integration.description: Automated integration tests present and passing.

e2e.description: End-to-end user journey tests present and passing.

security.description: Automated security regressions and penetration tests present.

authentication.description: Auth flow, MFA, and session invalidation test suites passing.

encryption.description: Cryptographic vectors and round-trip encryption/decryption tests passing.

upload.description: File upload validation and streaming chunk tests passing.

database.description: Database persistence, indexing, and connection tests passing.

dependencySecurity.title: Dependency Security
dependencySecurity.description: Supply chain security verification and static analysis scanning.

lockfileRequired.description: Must be true to mandate deterministic package lockfiles.

dependencyAudit.description: Whether automated npm security audits run in CI pipelines.

dependencyScanning.description: Whether automated vulnerability scanners inspect transitive dependencies.

secretScanning.description: Whether secret scanning prevents accidental credential commits.

sast.description: Whether Static Application Security Testing (SAST) runs on commits.

threatModel.title: Threat Model
threatModel.description: Specification of considered threats, security guarantees, and out-of-scope risks.

protectsAgainst.description: Threats against which the application design provides strong cryptographic or architectural mitigation.

outOfScope.description: Threat scenarios deliberately categorized as out-of-scope for the client-side zero-knowledge model.

compatibility.title: Platform Compatibility
compatibility.description: Target browser versions, supported device form-factors, and platform runtime prerequisites.

browsers.description: Minimum browser version matrix required for modern cryptographic primitives.

javascript.description: Whether modern JavaScript execution is required.

webCrypto.description: Must be true to mandate standard Web Cryptography API support.

secureContext.description: Must be true to require execution within a browser Secure Context (HTTPS or localhost).

pwa.title: Progressive Web App Specification
pwa.description: PWA installability, service worker caching, and offline access options.

installable.description: Whether web app manifest conforms to standalone installability standards.

serviceWorker.description: Whether service worker is registered for caching static application shell.

offlineSupport.description: Whether offline UI and cached state are available.

permissions.title: Runtime Permissions
permissions.description: Browser and hardware device capabilities requested by the application.

browser.description: Browser API permissions requested (e.g. notifications, clipboard-read).

device.description: Hardware device permissions requested (e.g. camera, microphone).

branding.title: Branding & Visual Theme
branding.description: Visual theme colors, icons, and theme awareness settings.

favicon.description: Relative path or URL to the brand favicon.

themeAware.description: Whether the application supports dynamic dark and light mode themes.

createdAt.description: Initial creation timestamp (ISO 8601 date or date-time).

updatedAt.description: Last updated timestamp (ISO 8601 date or date-time).
